gaps: Real IME composition and text commit were observed. Full gate remains unproven because candidate confirmation was not independently verified. EnterReturnsTrue was an extra observation, not a required acceptance condition if submission means IME commit.
Candidate UI screenshot absent: LOVE framebuffer captures exclude native OS candidate overlay. Candidate choice not independently asserted against displayed candidate UI.
Clearing the FFI buffer while InputText stayed active did not clear ImGui's edit state; final buffer retained injected 中文 prefix. Do not treat final buffer as a clean independent IME case.
Probe marks real-ime unverified unconditionally. It is an evidence collector for this failed experiment, not a completed passing acceptance suite.
No pure logic modules added, therefore no dual-interpreter busted claim.
decision: STOP #52 and dependent work (#62 onward); do not change stack or request manual acceptance. Independent tickets may proceed per coordinator. No GitHub comments or closures made per explicit instruction.
reproduce: Extract the pinned archive into a fresh empty external directory, verify archive/DLL hashes, then run ./prototypes/cjk-ime/verify.ps1 -DependencyDirectory <extracted-root>. Requires native interactive Windows desktop and installed Microsoft Pinyin; foreground keyboard events are restricted to the probe's own HWND. Expected result for this probe is failure.
